sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:27

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:27:1
items.html: The seven lower of Atik Yomin, which clothed in the seven corrections of the Galgalta of AA: As I wrote above: for the second Ibur, of the Mochin of the internality, ZA is obligated to attain the discernments of the HGT of Atik, which are turned and become HBD; and this applies only in the seven lower of Atik, clothed in the seven corrections of the Galgalta, which bestow there the discernment of HBD. And then he receives the Mochin of the GAR of the internality.
